title: 第57章 你觉得装，那就装一下吧

第57章 你觉得装，那就装一下吧-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

沈母盯着那辆车，两只脚钉在地上。

大伯先反应过来，干咳了一声，迈了一步，又停住，扭头看了大伯母一眼。大伯母的嘴张了张，什么都没吐出来。

林川没催，就那么站在车门旁边等着。

沈蔓上前挽住她妈的胳膊，轻轻拽了一下。“妈，上车。”

沈母这才动了，低头弯腰钻进后排，坐下的时候手不自觉地在真皮座椅上摸了一下。

大伯和大伯母跟着上了另一侧，大伯母坐进去的瞬间，屁股刚挨着座椅就往里缩了一截，生怕把人家东西弄脏了。

车门关上。

林川绕到驾驶位，拉门，坐进去，打火。

沈蔓坐在副驾，安全带扣好，侧头看了他一眼。

林川回了她一个很浅的眼神，什么都没说。

车子启动，驶出县城。

后排安静了大概三分钟。

大伯母终于憋不住了，身子往前探了探，声音压得比刚才在客厅里低了不止一个八度。

“小林啊，这个车……是你自己的？”

“是的，伯母。”

“那这个……得多少钱啊？”

林川一手搭在方向盘上，随口答了一句。

“八十来万吧。”

后排没人接话。

大伯母的嘴唇动了一下，又闭上了。

大伯的手搁在膝盖上，拇指搓了两下裤缝。

沈母坐在最里面，头微微偏向车窗，玻璃上映着她的半张脸。她在镇卫生院做护工，一个月八百块。

沈蔓侧过头看着窗外飞掠的田埂和电线杆，嘴角的弧度怎么都压不平。她用力抿了一下，还是没压住。

车上了高速之后，大伯母又说了几句话，但每一句的底气都比上一句弱，到最后基本只剩点头和“嗯嗯”。

大伯全程没再开口。

一个多小时后，车子下了高速，进了成都市区。

林川没往春熙路那种闹哄哄的地方开，而是直奔锦江边上的香格里拉酒店。他在深圳住惯了这个牌子，到哪儿第一反应都是找它。

车停在酒店门廊下，门童小跑过来拉开车门。

大伯母下车的时候腿有点发软，不是因为坐久了，是因为面前这栋楼太高了，高到她仰头都看不见顶。

门廊的水晶灯在头顶亮着，地面的大理石能照出人影，穿制服的服务员站成两排，每个人脸上都挂着标准的微笑。

她下意识拽了一下自己的外套，把拉链往上提了提。

大伯的步子慢了半拍，走在最后面，两只手不知道该往哪放，最后插进了夹克口袋里。

沈母被沈蔓搀着，一步一步跟在林川后面走进大堂。

脚踩在地毯上的触感让她有点恍惚。这辈子她去过最好的地方是县城的喜来福酒楼，办酒席的时候去的，一桌四百块，全家人都觉得贵。

前台的接待小姐看到林川走过来，还没等他开口就站直了身子。

“先生您好，请问是用餐还是入住？”

“中餐厅，包间。”

“好的，请稍等。”接待拿起电话，三十秒后放下，“先生这边请，锦绣厅已经为您准备好了。”

一行人跟着领位穿过大堂，坐电梯上了三楼。

包间的门推开，沈母的脚步顿了一下。

圆桌铺着绛红色的桌布，正中摆着一盆兰花，餐具是白瓷描金的，筷子架都是玉石的。窗帘半拉着，外面是锦江的夜景，水面上映着对岸的灯火。

服务员拉开椅子，一个一个地请人落座。

Mother Shen stared at the car with her feet nailed to the ground.

The uncle reacted first, coughed dryly, took a step, stopped, and turned to look at the aunt.The eldest aunt's mouth opened, but nothing came out.

Lin Chuan didn't rush, just stood by the car door and waited.

Shen Man stepped forward and took her mother's arm, gently pulling it."Mom, get in the car."

Only then did Mother Shen move. She lowered her head and bent down to get into the back row. When she sat down, her hand unconsciously touched the leather seat.

The uncle and aunt followed him to the other side. The moment the aunt sat in, her buttocks shrank inward as soon as they were next to the seat, for fear of soiling other people's things.

The car door closes.

Lin Chuan walked around to the driver's seat, opened the door, sat in, and turned on the ignition.

Shen Man sat in the passenger seat with her seat belt buckled and glanced sideways at him.

Lin Chuan gave her a very shallow look and said nothing.

The car started and drove out of the county.

The back row was quiet for about three minutes.

The eldest aunt finally couldn't hold it in any longer, leaned forward, and her voice was more than an octave lower than it was in the living room just now.

"Xiao Lin, this car...is your own?"

"Yes, Auntie."

"Then... how much does this cost?"

Lin Chuan put one hand on the steering wheel and answered casually.

"Eighty thousand or so."

No one in the back row answered.

The eldest aunt's lips moved and then closed again.

The uncle put his hands on his knees and rubbed the seams of his trousers twice with his thumbs.

Mother Shen sat in the back, her head tilted slightly toward the car window, half of her face reflected in the glass.She works as a nurse in the town health center, earning 800 yuan a month.

Shen Man turned his head and looked at the passing fields and telephone poles outside the window, and the curve of the corner of his mouth could not be flattened no matter how hard it was.She sipped it hard, but still didn't hold it down.

After the car got on the highway, the eldest aunt said a few more words, but each sentence was less confident than the previous one. In the end, she basically just nodded and "hmm".

The uncle didn't speak again the whole time.

More than an hour later, the car got off the highway and entered Chengdu city.

Lin Chuan did not drive to a noisy place like Chunxi Road, but went straight to the Shangri-La Hotel on the edge of Jinjiang River.He was used to this brand when he lived in Shenzhen, and his first reaction was to look for it wherever he went.

The car parked under the hotel porch, and the doorman trotted over and opened the door.

When the eldest aunt got out of the car, her legs were a little weak, not because she had been sitting for a long time, but because the building in front of her was so high that she couldn't even see the top when she raised her head.

The crystal lamp in the porch is lit overhead, and the marble on the ground can illuminate people's shadows. Uniformed waiters stand in two rows, each with a standard smile on their face.

She subconsciously tugged on her coat and lifted the zipper.

The uncle's steps slowed down for a moment, walking at the back. He didn't know where to put his hands, and finally put them into his jacket pockets.

Mother Shen was supported by Shen Man and followed Lin Chuan step by step into the lobby.

The feeling of her feet on the carpet made her feel a little dazed.The best place she has ever been to in her life is the Xilaifu Restaurant in the county town. She went there during a banquet. The price was 400 yuan per table, which the whole family thought was expensive.

The receptionist at the front desk saw Lin Chuan approaching and stood up straight before he could speak.

"Hello sir, would you like to have a meal or check in?"

"Chinese restaurant, private room."

"Okay, please wait a moment." The receptionist picked up the phone and put it down thirty seconds later. "Sir, please come this way. Jinxiu Hall is ready for you."

The group of people followed the leader through the lobby and took the elevator to the third floor.

When the door of the private room opened, Mother Shen's footsteps paused.

The round table is covered with a crimson tablecloth, with a pot of orchids in the middle. The tableware is made of white porcelain with gold accents, and the chopstick rests are made of jade.The curtains were half-opened, and outside was the night view of Jinjiang River, with lights from the other side reflected on the water.

The waiter pulled out the chairs and invited people to sit down one by one.
